name: instagram_get_media
description: One post in full: { id, caption, media_type, media_product_type, media_url, thumbnail_url, permalink, timestamp, username, like_count, comments_count }. This is how you turn the id instagram_publish_media returned into a `permalink` a human can open. `thumbnail_url` is set for video only.

media_id.description: Media id — the `id` instagram_publish_media returned, or one from instagram_list_media. Not a container id.
